senses.gloss:
तुज्, तुञ्ज् €1 P. (तुञ्जति; also Ā. and €10 P.) Ved.
—1 To reach, extend, convey.
—2 To kill, hurt, injure.
—3 To guard, protect.
—4 To clothe.
—5 To live.
—6 To strike, hit.
—7 To push.
—8 To emit, send forth.
—9 To incite, instigate, urge onwards.
—10 To give.
—11 To press out.
—12 To flow forth; सुरेतसा श्रवसा तुञ्जमाना Rv. 3. 1. 16.
तुज, तुञ्ज a. Ved. Noxious, mischievous, hurtful.

तुज, तुञ्ज + .{@-जः@}
—1 A shock, assault; तुञ्जेतुञ्जे य उत्तरे Rv. 1. 7. 7.
—2 A demon; यात किं विदिशो जेतुं तुञ्जेशो दिवि किं तया Ki. 15. 18.
—3 A thunderbolt.
—4 Giving.
—5 Pressure.
